Enquiry privacy notice · portfolio-enquiry-v1

A small enquiry should ask for little data.

This notice describes the enquiry flow prepared for this portfolio. Availability is checked before the form accepts submissions. It is not a statement that native hosted storage has already been provisioned.

Purpose and fields

Name, email, selected enquiry topic, optional organisation and optional message are used to review and respond to an enquiry. Do not send passwords, tokens, sensitive personal information or confidential documents.

Consent and marketing

The form requires confirmation that you have read this notice. Permission for occasional relevant updates is separate, optional and unchecked; submitting an enquiry does not enrol you for marketing. No mail delivery or mailing-list integration is currently asserted.

Storage and retention

The reviewed runtime stores enquiries in an owner-private database, with a receipt and a 90-day deletion deadline. Expired records are purged by the runtime. Production activation requires owner review of this notice, storage and operator process.

Access and erasure

Contact aboudy@keddeh.com to request access, correction or deletion. Include your registration reference where available. Identity should be confirmed privately before contact data is disclosed or changed.

Website access and third parties

The existing Site audience policy is preserved. Linked GitHub source pages and email applications operate under their own policies. No analytics or advertising scripts are added by this build.

Notice changes

Submissions bind the exact notice revision portfolio-enquiry-v1. A changed notice must be reviewed and assigned a new revision before new submissions are accepted.
